verification_methods: Recomputed all 27 witness convergents by exact integer arithmetic: for every row (d, a, CF) in both tables, the continuant recurrence reproduces a/d exactly, gcd(a,d)=1, and all partial quotients lie in the stated digit set (25 witnesses in {1,..,4}; the d=54 and d=150 witnesses in {1,..,5})

Independent DFS replication: from-scratch enumeration of CF words with digits {1,2,3} reproduces exactly the 27 uncovered denominators; digits {1,2,3,4} to bound 200 confirms 54 and 150 remain uncovered; adding digit 5 covers both

claim_reviews.claim: The 27 uncovered denominators for A={1,2,3} through the completed range are exactly 6,20,...,6234.
claim_reviews.evidence: Replicated from scratch by the signing reviewer (pure-Python DFS, independent of the CUDA code path): the uncovered set to 10^4 is exactly the published 27 (coverage of d is cutoff-independent once the cutoff exceeds d, so this determines list membership decisively). gpu_A123_1e9.log independently confirms at 10^9.

claim_reviews.claim: Adding digit 4 covers 25 of the 27; each listed witness (d, a, CF) is valid.
claim_reviews.evidence: All 25 witnesses recompute exactly: the continuant recurrence on each listed CF yields precisely a/d in lowest terms with all partial quotients <= 4. Example: [0;1,1,1,1,1,1,3,1,1,1,2,4,2,1] = 3845/6234 with gcd(3845,6234)=1. Zero errors in 25 rows — this table is fully machine-checkable and checks out.

claim_reviews.claim: d=54 and d=150 admit no representation with all partial quotients in {1,2,3,4} (exhaustive), and both are covered once digit 5 is allowed (witnesses 35/54 and 91/150).

The two digit-5 witnesses also recompute exactly ([0;1,1,1,5,2,1] = 35/54; [0;1,1,1,1,5,2,1,1] = 91/150).

claim_reviews.claim: The hierarchy 27 -> 2 -> 0 is a finite-range computational decomposition, not an analytic finiteness proof.
claim_reviews.evidence: This is precisely the correct epistemic framing, stated in the summary, the body, and the closing note. The 2026-04-23 audit correction note documents the earlier stale-list error transparently. Note one residual dependency: 'through the completed 10^10 run' inherits the partial-log issue flagged in the phase-transition review (the committed A123 10^10 log has no RESULTS block); the 27-list itself is unconditionally correct, and 10^9 completeness is log-certified.

overall_assessment: This is the strongest page in the collection from a verifiability standpoint: every single number on it is machine-checkable, and all of them check. 27/27 witnesses recompute exactly by integer arithmetic; the exception set replicates under an independent algorithm; the two hard cases are confirmed exhaustively; and the prose repeatedly and correctly disclaims analytic finiteness. The post-audit rewrite turned this into a model finding.
recommendations: Note that the committed A123 10^10 log is partial (exhaustiveness is log-certified at 10^9; list membership is certified independently of range)
